summary.text: Jonathan Martin has represented District 33 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Martin is an attorney who served as an assistant state attorney in Florida's 20th Judicial Circuit from 2008 to 2014 and as a Florida SouthWestern State College trustee from 2018 to 2022.
Martin was born in Cherokee, Iowa, moved to Florida in 1986, graduated from Stetson University in 2004 and received a J.D. from Liberty University School of Law in 2007.
